_doc: REVIEWED decisions on individual split events, applied by split_table.decide_splits. An entry decides the event of its symbol on event_date (any date a vendor lists for it, or a date nobody lists: an 'accept' then ADDS the split) outright, whatever the price jump says. Never a silent tolerance: every entry needs symbol, event_date (ISO), decision ('accept' needs a ratio = new shares / old shares; 'reject' drops the event), reason, added and reviewed_by; an entry whose reviewed_by starts with 'pending' REFUSES the build. A 'reject' also silences the 'unexplained_jump' review row at its date. The file's bytes are part of the split table's fingerprint. A 'reject' decides a split LISTING only: spin-off adjustments are computed from Alpaca's spin_offs and are never blocked by an override. KINDS: 'split' (default), 'spinoff' (ratio = the factor prices before the date are divided by; a split and a spinoff entry on one symbol/date compose, both applied) and 'bar_cap' (needs field High|Low and decision 'accept', no ratio): the BUILD caps that daily High/Low at the 5-minute all-session envelope bound, no witness needed (a row of bar_repairs.csv with witness 'override'); split_table.decide_splits never sees bar_cap entries.
